webhooks.detail: Webhook targets with event subscriptions, up to 25 per workspace; at-least-once delivery, ~12 retries over ~5 days; TypeScript webhooks SDK for signature verification. Targets managed in Plain app.

evidence.quote: Plain makes an `HTTP POST` request to this endpoint whenever an event you are interested in occurs.

sandbox.detail: No free dev sandbox found. Only a 7-day free trial, no credit card. Demo workspaces exist but no self-serve path documented.

evidence.quote: Start today, no credit card required.
